# Current package build

The active package is `eivGP` 0.3.0. Its canonical implementation is maintained
in `codes/`; `litr/create-eivGP.Rmd` is the sole active package build.

```sh
Rscript --vanilla litr/render-package.R
R CMD build eivGP
R CMD check --no-manual eivGP_0.3.0.tar.gz
```

Obsolete package/book sources have been removed from the working tree.
Use only the active literate build above to regenerate `eivGP/`.
See `README.md` for the current package interface and `DEVELOPMENT.md`
for the separate repository experiment workflow.
